subject: Model-improvement exclusion onboarding & transfer matrix
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@medsprint.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: legalops@medsprint.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Request: onboarding checklist for model-improvement exclusion + subprocessor transfer map

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking the call this morning. As discussed, MedSprint is moving forward with a pilot of your hosted inference API but we need a firm no-training (model-improvement exclusion) commitment and evidence of where our conversational data might flow. Legal wants an onboarding checklist we can track, plus a mapping of subprocessors and whether any transfer to EU/APAC is possible.

We attached our short RFI (Medsprint_RFI_llm_exclusion.xlsx) — items we care about:
- Confirmed contractual no-train clause and suggested DPA language we can sign.
- Technical guarantee that MedSprint data will not be used to update models (flag/ops controls).
- Subprocessor inventory, locations, and whether backups or logs land outside the US.
- Evidence artifacts: sample audit log export, retention policy, and any certificate or SOC attestation references.

High level timeline: legal would like an initial package by end of week so we can scope procurement and security review. Can you confirm?

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director, Security & Privacy
Medsprint

Attachments: Medsprint_RFI_llm_exclusion.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@medsprint.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding checklist for model-improvement exclusion + subprocessor transfer map

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear RFI. We can absolutely provide a packaged onboarding deliverable. High level commitments and evidence we can deliver this week:

1) Contract & DPA: we have a DPA addendum template that includes a contractual no-train (model improvement exclusion) clause. We will send DPA_Addendum_v1.pdf for your legal to review.

2) Operational control: Redwood provides a "no-train" runtime flag that prevents any customer input from being added to training datasets or model updates. We will include a short ops note and a screenshot of the control in Console.

3) Subprocessor inventory & transfers: we will provide our current inventory (subprocessor_inventory.csv) with locations and whether any storage/backups are routed outside the US. We also provide options to route preserved artifacts into your S3 (US-only) if you prefer.

4) Evidence: sample audit log export and retention policy excerpt (we'll include an example export with redacted IDs).

Action items for us (planned):
- Legal: send DPA addendum draft (we will attach).
- Engineering: produce sample audit export and confirm routing/residency options.
- PM/Customer Success: supply a one-page onboarding workback schedule.

Can you confirm the preferred data residency (US-only vs US+EU) and whether you want the preserved audit export delivered into your storage or as a Redwood-supplied file? If you confirm US-only, we can prioritize the routing change and include a mapping in the inventory.

I'll get the DPA addendum over by EOD and loop in Monica for procurement coordination.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: DPA_Addendum_v1.pdf (draft)

From: dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena@medsprint.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding checklist for model-improvement exclusion + subprocessor transfer map

Thanks Hannah — quick technical notes on implementation and evidence items so Legal can see the mechanics:

- No-train runtime: requests tagged with customer_id + "no_train=true" are routed through an ingestion gate that sets a processing attribute on all downstream stores. We have an internal audit event emitted for each request (event_type: training_optout_assertion). We can export a sample JSONL audit file containing those events (we'll redact tokens).

- KV/prefix cache: no_train traffic still benefits from caching for latency but the cache is treated as ephemeral and not used in model updates. The cache is memory-only on serving hosts and not persisted to long-term training stores.

- Logs & backups: application logs are retained for 30 days by default and samplings of request traces are sent to our tracing system. Persistent backups (for disaster recovery) are stored encrypted in US region by default; we can configure a customer-specific bucket if you want S3 in your account.

- Subprocessors: infra vendors (cloud provider compute and object storage), tracing vendor, our managed monitoring partner. We'll surface complete names and region info in subprocessor_inventory.csv. None of our core model training flows will consume your no_train-tagged data.

Let us know if MedSprint requires us to sign a clause that explicitly names the runtime flag and the export fields we will provide as evidence. Happy to bake that into the DPA addendum.

— Dev Patel
Senior Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)

From: monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: draft workback & procurement notes for MedSprint (for review)

Hannah / Dev — I put together a short workback schedule and procurement checklist for MedSprint. Key milestones: DPA addendum review (2 business days), security evidence pack (audit export + inventory) delivered (3 business days), legal sign-off and DocuSign (2–4 business days). I've attached workback_schedule.xlsx and flagged where we need signatures (Legal & Procurement).

Recommended language for the DPA addendum (short):
"Redwood will not use Customer Content for model training or model improvement. Customer Content tagged with no_train=true will be excluded from model pipelines, dataset construction, and human annotation activities. Redwood will provide audit logs and a subprocessor inventory showing processing locations."

Please review; I propose we send the DPA addendum + the inventory + workback as a single package to Elena tonight.

— Monica Patel
Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: workback_schedule.xlsx
